about.intro: Lawrence Energy Services Limited started in 2009 and became a registered company in 2012. We are an engineering and contracting firm. We install, fix and supply electrical and mechanical systems for factories, plants and big buildings. We also advise, test and train.
about.approach: We solve hard engineering problems with smart methods, and we keep getting better.
about.mission: To set the standard for smart engineering. We plan with cost in mind and finish projects on time and to a high standard.
about.vision: To become the leading home-grown engineering company in West Africa.
about.why_choose: We are a seasoned industrial engineering firm and general contractor. Clients know us for great service and strong results. We have worked on many high-profile projects that meet strict international standards. We work with global experts. And we keep our clients for a long time.
about.service_record: Our record shows quality, reliability and happy clients, confirming your project is in capable hands.

leaders.name: Lawrence Ehigie
leaders.title: Chairman & Managing Director
leaders.bio: Lawrence has more than 20 years in electrical engineering, factory installations, power systems and project management. He trained with Boulting Group in the UK from 1999 to 2003. He then led electrical and technical work at E-Jerrys Nigeria Limited (2003 to 2010) and headed the electrical department at IMPCO (2010 to 2012). Since 2012 he has led LESL as Chairman and Managing Director. He studied technical and engineering subjects at Benin Technical College and Federal Polytechnic Auchi.

faq.q: What engineering work does LESL perform?
faq.a: We install, test, and maintain electrical and mechanical systems. We also supply equipment, provide engineering consultancy, and train technical staff.
Factories, oil and gas firms, builders, offices, hotels, hospitals, schools, and public infrastructure agencies.

faq.q: What documentation is provided upon handover?
faq.a: A fully tested and commissioned system, accompanied by test reports, as-built drawings where needed, equipment manuals, statutory compliance certificates, warranty papers, and formal handover sign-off.

faq.q: How fast will you reply to a request?
Can I book a technical consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Sessions take place Monday to Friday between 9:00 am and 5:00 pm. Meetings run 30 to 60 minutes and can be conducted in person at our Lagos office or online.

faq.q: Do you work on commercial towers and residential complexes?
faq.a: Yes. We execute electrical and mechanical designs for mansions, shopping malls, and commercial towers, as well as industrial production plants.

faq.q: What geographic locations do you cover?
faq.a: All across Nigeria, including Lagos, Ogun, Kano, Bayelsa, Rivers, Abuja, Abia, Enugu, and Edo, as well as projects across Africa.
